result.instructions: Tools for Shipday, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Shipday data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run shipday_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run shipday_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run shipday_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. shipday_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: list_active_orders
tools.title: List active orders
tools.description: List the account's active (not yet completed) delivery orders with customer, pickup location (restaurant), assigned carrier/driver, timeline (activityLog), costs, payment method and orderStatus.orderState. Good first call. Shipday: GET /orders.

tools.name: get_order
tools.title: Get order by order number
tools.description: Get the details of a delivery order by its order number (the merchant's reference, `orderNumber`). Returns an array, since several orders can share one order number. Includes the numeric orderId needed by the write tools, the carrier, tracking link and status. Shipday: GET /orders/{orderNumber}.

order_number.description: The order number (orderNumber) of the order, e.g. "75637".

tools.name: query_orders
tools.title: Search orders (history)
tools.description: Search delivery orders, including completed ones, by placement-time window and status, with row-based paging: start_cursor/end_cursor select rows (e.g. 1–100, then 101–200; at most 100 per call) sorted newest first. Each row has timestamps (placement, assigned, picked up, delivered, failed), totals, driver payment, distance and carrier. Shipday: POST /orders/query.

start_time.description: Only orders placed at/after this ISO 8601 time (UTC), e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

end_time.description: Only orders placed at/before this ISO 8601 time (UTC).

end_cursor.description: Last row to return (default start_cursor + 99). At most 100 rows per call.

tools.name: get_pickup_order
tools.title: Get a pickup order
tools.description: Get a pickup (customer collects it) order by its numeric id, with restaurant, customer, items, costs, expected pickup date/time and status. Shipday: GET /pickup-orders/{orderId}.

order_id.description: Numeric id of the pickup order.

tools.name: get_delivery_progress
tools.title: Get delivery progress and ETA
tools.description: Real-time delivery progress of an order by its tracking id: status (STARTED, PICKED_UP, ...), timestamps, the driver's current location and the ETA in minutes. The tracking id is the last part of the order's trackingLink. Shipday's Business Advanced plan only; at most 3 requests per minute per tracking id. Shipday: GET /order/progress/{trackingId}.

tracking_id.description: The order's tracking id (from its trackingLink).

include_static_data.description: true = also return fixed details (customer, restaurant, carrier). Default false.

tools.name: list_carriers
tools.title: List carriers (drivers)
tools.description: List the account's carriers (drivers) with id, name, phone, email, isOnShift, isActive and last known location. Use an id here with assign_order_to_carrier. Shipday: GET /carriers.

tools.name: list_on_demand_services
tools.title: List on-demand delivery services
tools.description: List the third-party on-demand delivery services (DoorDash, Uber, ...) available to the account and whether each is enabled. Shipday: GET /on-demand/services.

tools.name: get_on_demand_estimate
tools.title: Get on-demand delivery estimates
tools.description: Get fee and time estimates from the third-party on-demand delivery services for an existing order (fee, pickup/delivery time, durations, per-service errors). Read only: nothing is booked. Shipday: GET /on-demand/estimate/{orderId}.

order_id.description: Shipday's internal numeric order id (the `orderId` field, not the order number).

tools.name: get_on_demand_details
tools.title: Get on-demand delivery details
tools.description: Details of the third-party on-demand delivery booked for an order: provider, reference id, third-party fee, Shipday charge, total billable amount and tracking URL. Shipday: GET /on-demand/details/{orderId}.

order_id.description: Shipday's internal numeric order id (the `orderId` field, not the order number).

tools.name: check_on_demand_availability
tools.title: Check on-demand delivery availability
tools.description: Quote third-party on-demand delivery for a pickup and delivery address before creating an order: which services can deliver, their fee and pickup/delivery times. Read only: nothing is booked. Shipday: POST /on-demand/availability.

tools.name: create_order
tools.title: Create a delivery order
tools.description: WRITE: insert a new delivery order into Shipday (it appears on the dispatch board; it is not assigned to a driver). Returns the new orderId. Times are UTC. Shipday: POST /orders.

customer_phone_number.description: Customer phone number with country code, e.g. +14155550100.

restaurant_phone_number.description: Pickup location phone with country code.

delivery_instruction.description: Instructions for the driver at delivery.

order_source.description: Where the order came from (free text).

tools.name: assign_order_to_carrier
tools.title: Assign an order to a driver
tools.description: WRITE: assign a delivery order to one of the account's own carriers (drivers); the driver is notified in the Shipday driver app. Re-assigning to the same driver changes nothing. Shipday: PUT /orders/assign/{orderId}/{carrierId}.

order_id.description: Shipday's internal numeric order id (the `orderId` field, not the order number).

annotations.title: Assign an order to a driver

tools.name: unassign_order
tools.title: Unassign an order from its driver
tools.description: WRITE: remove the driver from a delivery order (it goes back to unassigned). Shipday: PUT /orders/unassign/{orderId}.

order_id.description: Shipday's internal numeric order id (the `orderId` field, not the order number).

annotations.title: Unassign an order from its driver

tools.name: set_order_ready_to_pickup
tools.title: Mark an order ready for pickup
tools.description: WRITE: set or clear an order's ready-to-pickup flag (tells the driver the order is ready at the pickup location). Shipday: PUT /orders/{orderId}/meta.

order_id.description: Shipday's internal numeric order id (the `orderId` field, not the order number).

annotations.title: Mark an order ready for pickup
